opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell Home, my name is Ruud. How can I help?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.comment: The caller gave an order number, but you did not confirm their full name or postcode before sharing order details; you should have verified both before reading out the order and delivery address.

understanding.quote: What is it you'd like to do with it?
understanding.comment: The caller had already said they wanted to return the throw, so asking again was unnecessary and the question was repeated after they had stated their issue.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Unfortunately our return window is 14 days, so it's too late to return it.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy window is 30 days from delivery, so at 20 days the return was eligible and the statement was wrong.

process_compliance.comment: No required process step applied to this call, so this criterion is met.

communication.quote: I'm sorry I can't help more with this one.
communication.comment: You were polite, though the apology was tied to an incorrect refusal and the caller's disappointment was not clearly acknowledged.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: You asked if there was anything else and closed politely, but you did not confirm what happens next with the return.
